title: Benchmarking Speaker Embedders in the Sub-Second Regime for Real-Time Voice AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.09516v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-time Voice AI agents must separate the active user from intelligible background speech that survives conventional noise suppression. Background sources include television audio, family members, and colleagues. Production denoisers remove non-stationary environmental noise effectively. Background speech shares the spectral characteristics of the target and passes through, causing false acceptances in downstream speaker verification (SV) and automatic speech recognition (ASR). We benchmark open-source speaker embedders TitaNet-Large, TitaNet-Small, ECAPA-TDNN, CAM++, and SpeakerNet under a strict sub-second latency budget. Evaluation combines a controlled benchmark with a weighted human-annotated production set. Our controlled benchmark is built from real calls in which a second real speaker is injected into silence intervals at modulated amplitude. We report three findings. translated_title: 面向实时语音AI智能体的亚秒级说话人嵌入模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 实时语音AI智能体必须将活跃用户与穿透传统噪声抑制的、可理解的背景语音分离开来。背景语音来源包括电视音频、家庭成员和同事。生产级去噪器能够有效去除非平稳环境噪声，但背景语音与目标语音共享频谱特征，因此会穿透去噪器，导致下游说话人验证（SV）和自动语音识别（ASR）中的错误接受。我们在严格的亚秒级延迟预算下，对开源说话人嵌入模型TitaNet-Large、TitaNet-Small、ECAPA-TDNN、CAM++和SpeakerNet进行了基准测试。评估结合了受控基准测试与加权的人工标注生产数据集。受控基准基于真实通话构建，其中第二个真实说话人被以调制振幅注入到静音区间。我们报告了三项发现。第一，在嵌入之前进行去噪通常是有害的……
tldr: 该论文在严格的亚秒级延迟预算下对五种开源说话人嵌入模型进行了基准测试，发现嵌入前去噪通常有害，以评估其实时语音AI智能体中区分活跃用户与穿透传统降噪的背景语音的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper benchmarks five open-source speaker embedders under a strict sub-second latency budget for real-time voice AI agents, finding that denoising before embedding is generally harmful for separating active users from intelligible background speech that survives conventional noise suppression.
